description: Shorti(쇼티) for «make this with AI video» or «AI로 이 영상 만들려면?». A hit remade with the person's own AI video model, the original clip as its reference. `video_id` or `url` (or `format_id`: its reference hit) and a `mode`. One plan per model, each prompt written for the original clip and cut at the hit's cuts; `model`'s first request. Nothing generates here.

detail.description: summary: the compact answer, prompts for a model marked for_model. full: every field in both languages, paged by `cursor`.

format_id.description: A format: alone, its reference hit; with a hit, that hit in that format.

lang.description: 'en' answers in Shorti's own English: never translate its Korean.

model.description: Whose plan the answer carries: by default its first request (else the first model's); with detail='full' its every request (else every model's): seedance-2.5, minimax-h3, kling-3.0-motion-control, wan-3.0.

url.description: The hit, by the post's link.
